label: last copy steps of short sequences (esp. final output of L=3), or end-of-copy with input 0/2
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on <DEL>), and only on repeated inputs (in_first=0). Strongest and most reliable: the final output step of L=3 sequences (t=5, recall_idx=2): 95% of such steps are active, they hold ~43% of mass and nearly all top activations. Otherwise it concentrates on the last one or two copy steps (to_go<=1 holds 93% of mass), especially L=4 and when the fed-back input is digit 0 (10x lift) or 2. Rarely fires earlier in the copy of long sequences. The union predicate captures ~74% of mass on dev but precision is ~0.43: many end-of-copy steps with input 0/2 in long sequences are inactive, and L=4 end steps with letter inputs are missed.
